prompt: Gigi brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Big Toy Box Parade
irony: Gigi hauls home the biggest toy box to hold the most toys, but the empty toy box holds the kids instead, so the best thing inside is time together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun hits the street where a giant toy box towers by the big house gate.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy pats the giant toy box and names each toy picture while Gigi shouts surprise and Benny bounces.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox dares Teddy to open the giant toy box, but the lid sticks and the street crowd giggles.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Kids circle the giant toy box and chant the hook while feet stomp the street dust.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy reads the side label out loud and freezes at the tall flap while Benny believes Knox tall tale.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Benny dives inside the giant toy box, Knox tumbles after, and the toy box wobbles down the street.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Kids chase the wobbling toy box down the street and chant the hook shoulder to shoulder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gigi sits on the big house steps and admits the big toy box steals the play time.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gigi drops the extra toy bags and joins Benny inside the empty toy box for giggles.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Teddy leads the hook chant by the big house door while Gigi sings the turned line about time together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Kids chant the hook by the giant toy box home while morning sun hits shared toys on the mat.
